## **Цена и paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Цена и paywall.**
      3 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: цена и paywall.
      Период отзывов: 10 сент. 2026 г. - 12 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают цену, подписку или paywall. Это сигнал чувствительности к монетизации.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Revamped Rebel_, 12 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "basic features behind paywall. I was looking for a different app from renpho and heard good things about this app. imma just accept the new changes on renpho that I didn't like in exchange for this app not squeezing me."
            2. _Thursday_, 10 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "I've used MFP for over a decade. It used to be the perfect app, but with each update they made it harder to navigate, more and more cumbersome, and they keep taking features we already had and putting them behind a paywall. The app used to be laid out so you could easily see all of your information right up front. Now you have to dig to try to find anything."
            3. _Adam Voth_, 12 сент. 2026 г., 3/5: "the paywall is too high..."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Реклама** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Реклама.**
      1 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: реклама.
      Период отзывов: 10 сент. 2026 г. - 10 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи замечают давление рекламы. Это сигнал о friction в монетизации и возможном преимуществе для более чистого конкурента.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Natalie Kirk_, 10 сент. 2026 г., 4/5: "It's been good. Except today, it has started showing me ads with music! On my food journal entry log! Specifically Candy Crush ads with no option to mute them!!! PLEASE REMOVE ADS WITH SOUND. I DO NOT WANT BAD MUSIC BLASTING FOR EVERYONE TO HEAR WHILE I'M AT A CAFÉ ENTERING MY LUNCH!!!!!"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      5 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 6 мая 2026 г. - 12 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _enka cacka_, 21 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "broken app, checkout doesnt work, guided onboarding flashing and annoying, cant add a meal adds pop up and screen freeze. what a joke"
            2. _Ein Google-Nutzer_, 16 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "Demands an insane amount of access to your personal data. Also, the amount of ads has increased to a level that makes the app unusable."
            3. _Harun_, 4 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "I have been using this app for more than 10 years now. In the beginning it was the perfect app. But it is too laggy/buggy now. And also there is too much downtime lately. Other than that still an ok app to track macro's. UPDATE: THE LATEST UPDATE ON ANDROID SUCKS UNFORTUNATELY. I CAN'T DELETE A WHOLE MEAL AT ONCE ANYMORY, ALSO DON'T HAVE AN OVERVIEW OF MY MEALS LIKE ON THE WEB VERSION. I'M A PREMIUM USER AND I SERIOUSLY CONSIDER CANCELING MY SUBSCRIPTION! HOPE THIS WILL BE FIXED ASAP!"
<!--/ir-theme-->
